name: Erebos, God of the Dead
oracle_text:
Indestructible
As long as your devotion to black is less than five, Erebos isn't a creature. (Each {B} in the mana costs of permanents you control counts toward your devotion to black.)
Your opponents can't gain life.
{1}{B}, Pay 2 life: Draw a card.

needs.what: a player-wide static ability (affects_player: opponent/you/any) that, while its source is on the battlefield, stops the affected players' life totals from increasing: gain_life (and lifelink / any life gain path) does nothing for them, and life-gain triggers do not fire
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has replace_life_loss (multiplies losses only, not gains) and no gain prohibition; lock_life_total is a one-shot op with a fixed duration that forbids change in both directions for the named player, so it would also block life loss and would not track the permanent staying on the battlefield
